Searched 'inspector' (all 18 results, 3 pages), 'quadro', '1-4 կգ', 'ճիճուների', hafo's title words.

results.notes: hafo's row does not print the pipette count; single pipette inferred from price parity (hafo 4870 vs zoovet 1-pipette 4900 vs nemo 3-pack 11680).
